description: This Java class 'JunitSuiteWrapper' is used to load and manage JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with component configurations, resource handlers, and DOM elements to assemble test cases for execution.

classes.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
classes.description: A utility class to load and manage JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes test suites based on component name, suite name, and test case.

methods.name: populateTestSuite
methods.description: Deprecated method to populate a JUnit TestSuite with tests from the loaded model test suites.

methods.name: getModelTestSuites
methods.description: Returns the list of loaded ModelTestSuite objects.

methods.name: getAllTestList
methods.description: Returns a list of all Test objects from the loaded test suites.
